High A$139 = PriceCharting guide figures (PAL Advantage US$38.83 + VMU US$37.50 + rumble pak US$20.99, ASKING-type aggregates). lots.working: keep: lowest same-item SOLD per piece, untested/faulty: NES Advantage US$12.50 (A$17.91) + VMU dead screen US$9.99 (A$14.31) + N64 rumble pak untested US$16.00 (A$22.93) = A$55.15; /1.198 = A$46.03, round down to $45. flip: likely resale piece by piece = NES Advantage untested US$15 (A$21.49) + VMU US$24.99 (A$35.81) + rumble pak US$16 (A$22.93) = A$80.23; less eBay fees about 13% (A$10.43) and A$20 for outbound postage/packaging on three parcels = A$49.80; /2.396 = A$20.78, round down to $20.
